SHA256 hash identifying the artwork.
Number of pieces in the edition; reduced by burn operations.
Commission in basis points paid to the contract owner per sale.
Lowest price at which a piece is offered for sale.
Seller address of the current lowest ask.
Timestamp when the lowest ask was placed, used for cancel-sale delay.
Flag indicating whether a piece is currently for sale.
Highest bid currently placed for a piece.
Address of the current highest bidder.
Timestamp when the highest bid was placed, used for cancel/fill delays.
Timestamp when the contract was activated at construction.
Flag indicating whether an active bid exists.
Flag indicating whether the artist proof has been set.
Number of pieces awarded to the Ethart registrar.
Mapping of address to number of pieces owned.
Mapping of owner to spender to allowance used by transferFrom and burnFrom.
Address of the Registrar contract; receives Ethart commission and is called for patron issuance.
Constructor initializing artwork metadata, owner and activationTime.
Allows the current owner to assign a new owner; protected by onlyBy(owner).
Owner-only function that sets the proof and distributes initial pieces between owner and registrar.
ERC20 transfer of pieces with lock check against the lowest ask.
ERC20 transferFrom using allowance, with lock check.
Sets allowance for a spender.
Returns remaining allowance for a spender.
Burns caller pieces and decreases editionSize.
Burns pieces from another account using allowance and decreases editionSize.
Payable purchase of the piece on sale; splits value between owner, seller and registrar and issues patron tokens.
Offers a piece for sale at a new lowest ask; may trigger fillBid.
Payable bid placement; may trigger buyPiece for an instant sale.
Fills the outstanding bid; splits value and issues patron tokens.
Cancels the caller's bid after 24h and refunds value.
Cancels the caller's sale after 24h.
Returns the edition size as total supply.
Returns the number of pieces owned by an address.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization and fund flows.
Block timestamp (now) used for time-based delays and award randomness.
External ETH transfer of owner commission inside buyPiece before state is fully settled.
External ETH transfer of sale proceeds to the seller inside buyPiece.
External ETH transfer of Ethart commission to the registrar inside buyPiece.
External call to the registrar interface to issue patron tokens inside buyPiece.
External ETH transfer of owner commission inside fillBid.
External ETH transfer of proceeds to the bid filler inside fillBid.
External ETH transfer of Ethart commission to the registrar inside fillBid.
External call to the registrar interface to issue patron tokens inside fillBid.
External ETH refund of the bid to the bidder inside cancelBid.
Arithmetic reduction of editionSize in burn without underflow guard beyond balance check.
Arithmetic reduction of editionSize in burnFrom without underflow guard beyond balance check.
Arithmetic decrement of seller pieces in buyPiece; may underflow if seller on lowest ask owns nothing.

Integer division/multiplication used to compute owner commission in fillBid, causing truncation loss.
Constructor parameter for the owner commission in basis points.
Constructor parameter for the edition size.

Price parameter passed to offerPieceForSale.

Local variable holding the Ethart commission computed in buyPiece.

edges.reason: activationTime is set from now in the constructor.
changeOwner authorization depends on msg.sender matching owner via onlyBy modifier.
setProof is owner-only and gated on msg.sender via onlyBy(owner).
setProof uses now modulo 39 to randomly award a piece, creating timestamp dependency.
editionSize is read in setProof to compute ethartAward and owner pieces.
ethartAward is written in setProof.
transfer reads msg.sender to determine the sender balance.
transfer reads and writes piecesOwned balances.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the approved spender.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping for the spender.
transferFrom reads and writes piecesOwned balances.
approve writes the allowance for msg.sender as owner.
approve writes into the allowed mapping.
burn reads msg.sender balance before reducing it.
burn decreases editionSize by the burned amount.
burnFrom decreases editionSize by the burned value.
burnFrom uses msg.sender as the approved spender.
burnFrom decrements the allowed mapping of the spender.
buyPiece uses msg.sender as the buyer receiving pieces and patron tokens.
buyPiece checks pieceForSale before executing the sale.
buyPiece requires msg.value to be at least lowestAskPrice.
buyPiece reads ownerCommission to compute the owner payout.
buyPiece reads registrar to pay Ethart commission and call issuePatrons.
buyPiece decrements piecesOwned of the lowest ask address and increments the buyer, risking underflow.
buyPiece computes msg.value / 10000 * ownerCommission inside buyPiece.
buyPiece transfers the computed commission to the owner address.
buyPiece transfers seller proceeds to lowestAskAddress.
buyPiece transfers the Ethart commission to the registrar address.
buyPiece passes msg.sender as the patron token recipient to issuePatrons.
External ETH transfer to owner during buyPiece can re-enter the contract before state is finalized.
External ETH transfer to the seller during buyPiece can re-enter before pieceForSale is cleared.
External ETH transfer to registrar during buyPiece can re-enter the contract.
External call to issuePatrons on the registrar can re-enter buyPiece.
offerPieceForSale compares the new price to the current lowestAskPrice.
offerPieceForSale compares the new price to highestBidPrice to trigger an instant fill.
offerPieceForSale records msg.sender as lowestAskAddress.
offerPieceForSale writes now into lowestAskTime and uses timestamp in the ethArt modifier.
offerPieceForSale calls fillBid when the price is at or below the highest bid.
lowestAskTime is written by offerPieceForSale.
placeBid records msg.sender as highestBidAddress.
placeBid compares msg.value against highestBidPrice and later assigns it.
placeBid checks pieceForSale and lowestAskPrice to decide instant sale.
placeBid writes now into highestBidTime, a timestamp-dependent delay.
placeBid calls buyPiece when the bid meets the lowest ask.
fillBid uses msg.sender as the piece seller filling the bid.
fillBid requires pieceWanted to be true before executing.
fillBid ownerFirst modifier compares now against highestBidTime.
fillBid relies on now in ownerFirst and ethArtOnlyAfterOneYear modifiers, creating timestamp dependency.
fillBid reads ownerCommission to compute the owner payout.
fillBid reads highestBidPrice to determine the sale amount.
fillBid computes highestBidPrice / 10000 * ownerCommission causing truncation.
fillBid reads registrar for commission payment and issuePatrons call.
fillBid transfers the owner commission to the owner address.
fillBid transfers the Ethart commission to the registrar address.
External ETH transfer to owner during fillBid can re-enter before pieceWanted is cleared.
External ETH transfer to msg.sender during fillBid can re-enter the contract.
External ETH transfer to registrar during fillBid can re-enter the contract.
External call to issuePatrons inside fillBid can re-enter the contract.
cancelBid requires now to be greater than highestBidTime plus one day.
cancelBid uses now to enforce the 24 hour withdrawal delay, a timestamp dependency.
cancelBid refunds highestBidPrice to the caller.
External ETH refund in cancelBid occurs before highestBidPrice is cleared, enabling reentrancy.
cancelBid is restricted via onlyBy(highestBidAddress) to the current bidder.
cancelSale requires now to be greater than lowestAskTime plus one day.
cancelSale uses now to enforce the 24 hour cancellation delay, a timestamp dependency.
cancelSale is restricted via onlyBy(lowestAskAddress) to the current seller.
_ownerCommission parameter is validated and stored by the constructor.
_editionSize parameter is stored into editionSize by the constructor.
newOwner parameter is assigned to the owner state variable.
_amount parameter of transfer drives the balance updates.
_price parameter of offerPieceForSale is stored as lowestAskPrice.
_amountOwner local is used in buyPiece to pay the owner.
_amountEthart local is used in buyPiece to pay the registrar.
_amountSeller local is used in buyPiece to pay the seller.
patronReward local is passed to issuePatrons in fillBid.
